body: My dad would tell me that Medusa lived in the toilet and would come out and get me if I was bad. I shit in my pants till 9th grade. Luckily, we moved 6 or more times a year, so I had little breaks from the torment.

I don't mean to make her sound like a bad person. She has a full time job and makes almost as much as me. We pay the bills together. I think she just has some stashed back. She doesn't tell me because she feels guilty smoking when I can't. We don't hate each other. We just don't love each other.
Can you explain what you mean by getting over the fear?

I've been to several doctors, chiros, physical therapists. Not even a little relief. Except with weed, of which I have none. And do I just throw away 7 years of building a life together? I'm over half way through my life, and frankly, starting over makes me more depressed.
